text.description: Exact NFC text, at most 280 X-weighted characters. No general mentions, quote/reply parameters, private information, or identifying the user. A server-configured exact one-time original canary may include only its approved recipient.

in_reply_to_post_id.description: Canonical positive decimal ID, 1–19 digits per X API. Never convert to a JavaScript Number.

in_reply_to_author_id.description: Canonical positive decimal ID, 1–19 digits per X API. Never convert to a JavaScript Number.

idempotency_key.description: A new lowercase UUID v4 for a new intent. Retain this key after any timeout. Never change it to retry an uncertain publication.
